recommendation.verdict: MiMo-V2.6 q4 is a fast local drafting tool, not a GLM replacement: 49/72 vs 71/72 with 2/8 vs 8/8 runnable-as-is. Use it for throwaway/simple Python drafts with mandatory run-verification; keep GLM for MQL5, WordPress, shell, timing-sensitive and review-free deliverables. The one strong signal: on no category did MiMo beat GLM, and its failure mode (confident fictional APIs, silently-wrong shell) is the expensive kind.
